paragraphs.text: A rain garden is a shallow hollow planted with grasses that takes water from a roof or a road. The water soaks away within a day, so mosquitoes cannot breed. Such gardens cost less than new drains.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: One city planted 300 of them along a single avenue. After two years, flooding of cellars during storms had stopped, although the city still needs its main sewer for very heavy rain.
paragraphs.label: B

items.prompt: Rain gardens hold water for several days.
Rain gardens are cheaper than building new drains.
The city has closed its main sewer.
Residents paid for the gardens themselves.

groups.instruction: Questions 1–4. Do the following statements agree with the information in the text? Write TRUE, FALSE or NOT GIVEN.
